items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Me and him just started together in Sox's Lane. Mm-hmm. That's been years ago. Mm-hmm. And then we made up a band with Skeeter.

ctx.x: I heard him on records. Yeah. With Freddie Kepler.

With Freddie Kepler. That's right. Mm-hmm. Well, I was the one who pitched him. Mm-hmm. Yeah. Me and him just started together in Sox's Lane. Mm-hmm. That's been years ago. Mm-hmm. And then we made up a band with Skeeter. Like you see, it was Skeeter and different fellas. And I coached him playing all around. And then I started to take a lesson with the violin. You understand? I was playing to get all my cymbals. I didn't play in the band without him. Mm-hmm. After I started taking lessons, I got to divide and I…

items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Me and him learned together. And he started playing trombone with me.

ctx.x: Who were the trombones over there?

Buddy. Buddy Johnson. Buddy Johnson. Buddy Johnson. Buddy Johnson and the, what's this other trombone, and Eddie Vincent, he learned with me. Me and him learned together. And he started playing trombone with me. Excelsior. Yeah. Yeah. Well he started playing trombone.
Did you play, was the, who was the Excelsior band? Well I never did play with Excelsior.
